text.description_html:
Mckinney 4007, Double Acting Spring Pivot Hinge

The Mckinney 4007 Double Acting Spring Pivot Hinge allows doors to self return to center. Equipped with anti-friction bearings in the base and top socket, it allows light and heavy gates to swing both ways while minimizing wear. Surface-mounted attachments and a bottom-box design allow easy installation on any door or gate. Ideal for courtroom doors, restaurant kitchen doors, park gates, cafe doors, and commercial swinging doors.

Specifications of the Non-Adjustable Spring Tension Surface Pivot Hinge:

  • Finish: Satin Chrome
  • Cast Steel Construction
  • Double Acting
  • Maximum Swing: 130º each direction
  • Ball Bearing Pivot
  • Non-Handed
  • Non-Adjustable Spring Tension
  • Minimum Clearance: 2-3/8"
  • Door Thickness: 1-1/8 - 2-1/2"
  • Door Width: 3'0"
  • Door Weight: 75lbs
  • Width of Jamb Attachment: 1-1/4"

Sold individually as a set, with 1 pivot , 1 each jamb and door bracket, 1 top pivot assembly with jamb bracket, and mounting screw hardware. Enough to do one door.

Sold Individually.
